intro.screen1: Veth, Rill and Nova are at the base station. They are responsible for sending medicines and other supplies to three different stations.
intro.screen2: First station: Rock Post — a small outpost, nearby. A little crew lives here.
intro.screen3: Second station: Lake Station — a mining camp, quite far from the base station. More families live here.
intro.screen4: Third station: Titan City — a big research dome. It is a big city, and a large population lives here.
intro.screen5: Nova, you have to help Rill load the shuttles with the required medicine supplies to send to all three stations.
screen6: Before launching the shuttles, we have to load the correct shipments.
I am going to tell you the amount, and you will put the correct number on this panel.
The shuttle will launch only when the correct amount is filled on the panel.

commas.narrator: Level 2: The Indian and International Number Systems.
commas.title: POPULATION REPORTS
commas.requests: REQUESTS FROM INDIAN AND INTERNATIONAL HEADQUARTERS
teach: We received requests from both Indian and International headquarters!
Let's add commas according to each number system to make the reports easier to read!
The Indian and International number systems group digits in different ways.
The Indian number system uses thousands, lakhs and crores to read large numbers.
Start from the right. Count three digits and put a comma. This is the Ones group.
Again, count two digits and put another comma. This is the Thousands group.
Now count two more digits for the Lakhs group. The remaining digit is in Crores!
We read this as four crore thirty-two lakh fifty-six thousand seven hundred eighty-one.
The International number system uses thousands, millions and billions. Here, commas follow a different pattern!
Start from the right again. Count three digits and put a comma. This is the Ones group.
Now count three more digits and add a comma. This is the Thousands group.
The remaining digits belong to the Millions group. For even bigger numbers, we use Billions!
We read this as forty-three million two hundred fifty-six thousand seven hundred eighty-one.
Indian grouping uses three digits, then pairs of two.
International grouping uses groups of three throughout!
Now prepare the population reports for both headquarters!
commas.transitionIdle: Tap CONTINUE to prepare the reports.
